clips.title: The story
paras: Verner Osgood has run out of iron in Lakeshire, where the guard's gear needs constant repair. He sends you west across Elwynn Forest to ask Smith Argus in Goldshire for horseshoes.

Lakeshire faces gnolls, orcs, and murlocs, while Stormwind sends little help. The garrison fights each day to keep the town from falling, and battle quickly wears down its gear. Verner Osgood spends nearly every waking hour repairing dented breastplates, reshaping dulled swords, and keeping the guards clad in iron. The work has exhausted his supply of raw materials.

Without iron, even ordinary work in a frontier town can stop. Horses without shoes cannot carry messengers swiftly or haul supplies along Redridge's rocky paths. Verner swallows his pride and sends you west along the Three Corners road to Goldshire. Smith Argus there still has regular access to the kingdom's mineral stores.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I've been using so much iron keeping the Stormwind Guards outfitted, I don't have enough to supply the stable's horses with shoes!
Take this note to Blacksmith Argus in Goldshire. It explains to him my problem and requests a shipment of horseshoes.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What's that? Verner sent you, you say? Well give me his note. And SPEAK UP!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Heh, so old Verner needs some shoes, does he!?!
